answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The jetty holds work receipts rather than names, so the wander of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the tide is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
